Patch Set 15: Code-Review+2
Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as a47b65d024a8ad24236a090eed421ccd99c07863
Please resolve merge conflicts.
What is the point of them if we do not have any inventory objects created as a result?

These GPIODeviceDetect entries do not create inventory objects by themselves.

The intent is to enable the existing gpio-presence flow to track removable device present/absent transitions and report insertion/removal through journal logs.

I updated the commit message to make this clearer.

Who is anticipated to consume those?  We don't do diagnostics through parsing journal logs.  Is this just for manufacturing?

Which of these parts are already represented by EEPROMs?  If they have an EEPROM we don't also need a GPIO-based presence detect.

If these parts don't have an EEPROM, but they are possibly removable, why don't we have an inventory object for them?

The intent was not to use journal log parsing as a diagnostics mechanism.

This requirement came from the DFT team to provide visibility for removable device present/absent transitions. EEPROM-backed devices can create inventory objects, but hot-removal may not immediately provide a clear removal transition to the user. The GPIODeviceDetect entries were added to expose present/absent transitions through the existing gpio-presence flow.

Another option is to use the GPIO transition to trigger FruDeviceManager.ReScanBus for the affected FRU bus, so EEPROM-backed inventory is refreshed when the removable device state changes. I can rework the change in that direction if preferred.
Correction: this requirement came from the RTP team, not the DFT team.

> Another option is to use the GPIO transition to trigger FruDeviceManager.ReScanBus for the affected FRU bus, so EEPROM-backed inventory is refreshed when the removable device state changes. I can rework the change in that direction if preferred.

Yes, please do this.  If a hot-remove isn't correctly supported, add support for it.
Should this commit be abandoned and "Add cable inventory presence" reordered to be directly on master?

Updated to support the hot-remove flow by triggering FruDeviceManager.ReScanBus() from the presence GPIO changes.
New Gerrit change: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openbmc/+/91006

I also split "Add cable inventory presence" into a separate change and rebased it directly on master, so it no longer depends on this commit.
This doesn't do any good if there aren't Asset information associated with it.
Done in the previous patch set.
Please resolve merge conflicts.
Why not put this in a separate file?
Done. Moved the CPU inventory entry to a separate anacapa_cpu.json file.
